erin (Finance): Quick heads-up: next billing cycle we'll publish an "overage clarity" update. Main goals: make overage math explicit on invoices and add a pre-bill preview so customers see potential overage charges before invoicing.

mike (Billing Eng): TL;DR: new invoice rows for 'projected_overage_preview' (console only) and 'actual_overage' (invoice). No change to existing rate rules or caps. Preview is generated daily for orgs that opt in.

zoe (Product): UX notes: console banner will show a one-line estimate and a link to the preview page. Customers can opt-out of previews. We'll show last-7d usage and projected overage cost if trends continue.

kyle (Support): Customer question: will previews trigger billing disputes?

erin (Finance): No. Previews are advisory only. Dispute windows and refund policy unchanged. Only 'actual_overage' on invoices is billable.

mike (Billing Eng): Implementation: feature flag + opt-in. Preview CSV schema minimal: org_id,period_start,period_end,estimated_overage_cents,assumed_rate_cents_per_token. No prompt data included.

billing-bot: deploy started: billing-preview-service:v1.2.0 -> canary 5%  runbook: /runbooks/overage-preview

erin (Finance): Comms: KB article + short release note to active billing contacts + blog post with examples. Also adding a sample PDF showing how preview maps to invoice lines.

oliver (CEO): Good. Make sure Sales & Support get the one-pager — helps conversations about Reserved Capacity.

zoe (Product): Rollout plan: beta opt-in -> 15% -> 50% -> 100% over 10 days. Track #opt-ins, preview accuracy (est vs actual), support tickets opened after preview.

mike (Billing Eng): Deploy success: billing-preview-service:v1.2.0 canary healthy (2026-03-23T23:05:12Z)

erin (Finance): Final copy for KB blurb: "New: billing previews show estimated overage charges before invoicing. Previews are advisory; only invoice line items are billable. Opt in from Billing Settings." Feedback welcome.

kyle (Support): I'll prepare canned responses and an internal triage playbook for preview-related questions.

erin (Finance): Launching beta sign-ups tomorrow 09:00 PT. DM me if you want internal test access. :sparkles:
